nodes.speaker: system
nodes.text: Incoming Priority Message from Earth Mission Control: All Martian Arctic data from Phoenix is logged and verified! Explorer Crew, you are officially cleared to unlock and explore Deep Space!

nodes.speaker: felice
nodes.text: Meow!! Did you hear that message from Earth?! Mission Control just unlocked our Deep Space navigation corridor—beyond Mars, past the Asteroid Belt, all the way out to the outer giant worlds!

nodes.speaker: felice
nodes.text: I'm locking the navigation console coordinates for Deep Space right now! Hang onto your whiskers, explorers—our console is about to travel through Deep Space to humanity's very first Deep Space mission: Pioneer 10 and 11!
